# Endpoints

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen_api_reference.py — don't edit by hand; run `pnpm api` in docs/. -->

Every endpoint of the Open API, generated from the FOID backend. The examples are real responses from a
test-mode run (sandbox data). Base URL: `https://api.foid.ng/api/open/v1` (locally `http://localhost:8000/api/open/v1`).
Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer FOID_TEST_…` (or `FOID_LIVE_…`) — except the token endpoint, which
uses the sign-in app's client credentials. See [Overview](./) for auth, errors and limits.

## Connection

### GET `/ping` {#get-ping}

**Response `200`**

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "organisation": "Acme Wallet",
  "env": "test"
}
```

## Verifications

Hosted verification: create a link, send the person to it, read the result.

### POST `/verifications` {#post-verifications}

Optional header: `Idempotency-Key` — repeat the same request safely (same key + same body = same result).

**JSON body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_ref` | string |  | Your own id for this person; max length 128 |
| `subject_id` | string |  |  |
| `first_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `middle_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `last_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `date_of_birth` | string |  | pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `email` | string (email) |  |  |
| `phone` | string |  | max length 20 |
| `checks` | array of `nin` \| `bvn` \| `liveness` \| `reverify` | yes | min items 1 |
| `scopes` | array of `contact` \| `financial` |  |  |
| `purpose` | string | yes | Shown to the person on the consent screen; min length 3; max length 200 |
| `return_url` | string |  | max length 500 |
| `metadata` | object |  |  |

::: details Example request
```json
{
  "checks": [
    "nin",
    "liveness"
  ],
  "purpose": "Open a wallet",
  "customer_ref": "cust_1001",
  "first_name": "Ada",
  "last_name": "Obi",
  "return_url": "https://acme.example/onboarding/done"
}
```
:::

**Response `201`**

```json
{
  "id": "d9588b86-660a-4737-a7a4-ff70ef99ed35",
  "object": "verification",
  "env": "test",
  "status": "pending",
  "outcome": null,
  "checks": [
    "nin",
    "liveness"
  ],
  "scopes": [
    "identity",
    "liveness"
  ],
  "purpose": "Open a wallet",
  "subject_id": "c9981038-6db3-4236-8fca-d8bbb89dadfa",
  "customer_ref": "cust_1001",
  "consent": {
    "status": "none",
    "scopes": []
  },
  "reused_foid_credential": false,
  "results": {
    "nin": {
      "status": "pending"
    },
    "liveness": {
      "status": "pending"
    }
  },
  "metadata": {},
  "expires_at": "2026-11-04T20:25:01.979339+00:00",
  "completed_at": null,
  "created_at": "2026-11-03T20:25:01.979556+00:00",
  "hosted_url": "https://app.foid.ng/verify/vs_\u2026",
  "client_token": "vs_\u2026"
}
```

## Checks

Server-to-server checks. You attest you collected the person's consent.

### POST `/checks/nin` {#post-checks-nin}

Look up an NIN and match it against the name / date of birth you send.

Optional header: `Idempotency-Key` — repeat the same request safely (same key + same body = same result).

**JSON body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_ref` | string |  | Your own id for this person; max length 128 |
| `subject_id` | string |  |  |
| `first_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `middle_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `last_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `date_of_birth` | string |  | pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `email` | string (email) |  |  |
| `phone` | string |  | max length 20 |
| `number` | string | yes | 11-digit NIN or BVN |
| `consent` | object | yes |  |
| `consent.obtained` | `true` | yes | You confirm you collected the person's consent for this check |
| `consent.purpose` | string | yes | min length 3; max length 200 |

::: details Example request
```json
{
  "number": "12345678901",
  "first_name": "Ada",
  "last_name": "Obi",
  "date_of_birth": "1994-03-12",
  "customer_ref": "cust_1001",
  "consent": {
    "obtained": true,
    "purpose": "Account opening"
  }
}
```
:::

**Response `200`**

```json
{
  "id": "880af60a-e95c-4679-b205-21e710d775e9",
  "type": "nin",
  "status": "passed",
  "reasons": [],
  "data": {
    "method": "number",
    "nin_last4": "8901",
    "name_match": true,
    "name_score": 1.0,
    "dob_match": true,
    "record": {
      "first_name": "Ada",
      "middle_name": null,
      "last_name": "Obi",
      "date_of_birth": "1994-03-12"
    }
  },
  "provider": "mock",
  "verification_id": null,
  "subject_id": "c9981038-6db3-4236-8fca-d8bbb89dadfa",
  "created_at": "2026-11-03T20:25:02.091651+00:00",
  "customer_ref": "cust_1001"
}
```

### POST `/checks/bvn` {#post-checks-bvn}

Look up a BVN and match it against the name / date of birth you send.

Optional header: `Idempotency-Key` — repeat the same request safely (same key + same body = same result).

**JSON body**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_ref` | string |  | Your own id for this person; max length 128 |
| `subject_id` | string |  |  |
| `first_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `middle_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `last_name` | string |  | max length 80 |
| `date_of_birth` | string |  | pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` |
| `email` | string (email) |  |  |
| `phone` | string |  | max length 20 |
| `number` | string | yes | 11-digit NIN or BVN |
| `consent` | object | yes |  |
| `consent.obtained` | `true` | yes | You confirm you collected the person's consent for this check |
| `consent.purpose` | string | yes | min length 3; max length 200 |

### POST `/checks/nin-document` {#post-checks-nin-document}

Extract the NIN from a document image (OCR), then look it up. The document photo is not used.

**multipart form**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes | Photo/scan of an NIN slip or NIMC card |
| `consent_obtained` | boolean | yes |  |
| `purpose` | string | yes | min length 3; max length 200 |
| `customer_ref` | string |  |  |
| `subject_id` | string |  |  |
| `first_name` | string |  |  |
| `middle_name` | string |  |  |
| `last_name` | string |  |  |
| `date_of_birth` | string |  |  |

Returns the same shape as [`POST /checks/nin`](#post-checks-nin), plus the NIN read from the document (last 4 only).

## Subjects

The people you have verified. Every read goes through the person's consent.

### GET `/subjects` {#get-subjects}

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_ref` | query | string |  |
| `limit` | query | integer |  |

### GET `/subjects/{subject_id}/trust-report` {#get-subjects-subject-id-trust-report}

Financial trust signals + living credential state. FOID account holders only, scope `financial`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | path | string | yes |

**Response `403`**

```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "permission",
    "code": "scope_not_granted",
    "message": "No active consent for scope 'financial'"
  }
}
```

### DELETE `/subjects/{subject_id}` {#delete-subjects-subject-id}

Erase a subject and everything FOID holds about them for your business (checks, face, consent).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | path | string | yes |

**Response `204`** — no body

## Continue with FOID

Exchange the one-time code from the sign-in popup. Client credentials, not the API key.

### POST `/oauth/token` {#post-oauth-token}

**Form body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or JSON)

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `grant_type` | yes | `authorization_code` |
| `code` | yes | The one-time code from the popup. Single use, expires after 60 seconds. |
| `code_verifier` | yes | The PKCE verifier that matches the `code_challenge` used to start sign-in. |
| `redirect_uri` | redirect mode | Exactly the one used to start sign-in (`response_mode=query`). |
| `client_id` + `client_secret` | one auth method | Or HTTP Basic `client_id:client_secret` (recommended). |
| `client_assertion_type` + `client_assertion` | one auth method | `private_key_jwt`: an ES256/RS256 JWT, `iss`=`sub`=client ID, `aud`=this URL, expires ≤ 5 min. |

Errors use OAuth's format: `{"error": "invalid_grant", "error_description": "…"}`.

**Response `200`**

```json
{
  "object": "foid_sign_in",
  "env": "test",
  "sandbox": true,
  "nonce": "n_51b7",
  "subject_id": "ce669b19-ced4-4ff9-ac99-01d560450380",
  "scopes": [
    "contact",
    "identity",
    "profile"
  ],
  "foid_account": true,
  "face_rematched_at": null,
  "subject": {
    "id": "ce669b19-ced4-4ff9-ac99-01d560450380",
    "customer_ref": null,
    "env": "test",
    "consent": {
      "status": "active",
      "scopes": [
        "contact",
        "identity",
        "profile"
      ]
    },
    "has_foid_account": true,
    "created_at": "2026-11-03T20:25:02.497513+00:00",
    "first_name": "Chiamaka",
    "middle_name": null,
    "last_name": "Eze",
    "date_of_birth": "1990-01-01",
    "nin": {
      "verified": true,
      "last4": "0001"
    },
    "bvn": {
      "verified": true,
      "last4": "0002"
    },
    "email": "sandbox.person@example.com",
    "phone": "**********0001"
  },
  "checks": []
}
```
